notes: Renamed Trail to NoBo (and will use SoBo after the pivot)
Stopping at Ed Garvey shelter for lunch.

It took a few miles for my nerves to settle. Alone now at Crampton Gap shelter. I think I'm well ahead of the north bounders from Georgia. It might take more time to socialize in to the AT culture than during my southbound attempt.
Started earlier than I need to. Lunch goal is a barbeque place 6 miles from where I camped. Opportunity for a hot shower today at Dahlgren campground.
Shower and a break at Dahlgren campground. Then a BBQ sandwich up Alt 40.
At the site of the first Washington Monument.
Pine Knob shelter. Resisting the urge to do 3 more miles to a non-shelter campground. I have a hot-spot on my right foot that needs tending.
Lunch at Ensign Cowall Shelter. Might skip Waynesboro and wait til Fayetteville before restocking food. May be able to order pizza to PenMar Park.

Raven Rock Shelter. Listening to carpenter bees chew on the rafters. Crossing into PA tomorrow, shooting for a 13 mile day. Day after tomorrow, hitch into Fayetteville and sleep in a hostel, possibly.

20 miles on trail, 22 total walked today. Sorry for no lunch update I was challenging myself. The two mile detour was to eat a whole pizza and drink 3 root beers. In shelter now, alone, will be wet and dark tonight.
Early lunch at Quarry Gap shelter. The nicest shelter in PA, I'm told.
No service for a bit there! There's a deli up the road but I'll have some pack food and sit for 30m.
At the Rock Maze south of the shelter I'll camp at tonight.
Shelter was crowded, acquired lodging elsewhere...
Taking a Zero Day. At the Trout Gallery of Dickinson College.
Darlington shelter. Rocksylvania starts tomorrow.
Duncannon PA - The AT goes right down the main street. Stopped at a pub for a cheesesteak lunch. Bought some gear I've been needing. Just 5 more miles to shelter.
Passed through Duncannon, despite hostels. Now at Clark's Ferry Shelter 5m up into Rocksylvania territory. Will assess pace tomorrow given the new train conditions.
At the Stay-AT-Swatara hostel for a shower and laundry, then back on the trail for 7 more miles.

William Penn shelter.
Gonna reduce mileage between here and Hamburg PA to account for Rocks - let my feet acclimate.

Less than 1k miles to Katahdin.
Lunch at Hertline Campground. Lovely reservoir with a rope swing.
Camped near the Black Swatara spring.
Chinese buffet.
Over the mountain out of Port Clinton. Probably my last zero day with the wife. Straight to Erebor!
